name: Kisoki throws off Bornu

summary.text: Kano had paid tribute to Bornu since Abdullahi Burja. While Songhai and Bornu were torn by internal strife, Muhammad Kisoki marched into Bornu, then beat off the mai's counter-attack, ending Bornu's overlordship. The Kano Chronicle credits him with ruling “all Hausaland, east and west, north and south”.

routes.label: Kisoki's expedition into Bornu
routes.note: Start and Bornu's capital only; how far he went is not recorded.

moments.title: Bornu's reprisal fails
moments.text: The mai marches on Kano and is decisively repelled.

reviewNotes: Bornu's chronicles have not been checked for this war; the Kano account may flatter Kisoki.
